notes:
Background: SparrowCode builds a VS Code extension aimed at mid-market engineering teams. Primary differentiator is ultra-low-latency inline suggestions and uninterrupted streaming completions for large files.

Quick summary / customer voice: 'We need suggestions that feel native — no 1–2s pauses, per-keystroke streaming is ideal.' They want model/version pinning so customers can choose stable model for teams.

Technical requirements (from discovery):
- End-to-end first-token latency target: <= 150ms for US devs; goal 80-120ms.
- Per-token streaming latency ideally < 40ms.
- Concurrent active developers during peak: 1,200 (internal) and expected multi-tenant bursts for enterprise customers.
- Rate limits: per-org and per-user throttles; per-route quotas and token caps; graceful 429 handling and client backoff hooks.
- Auth: GitHub OAuth for consumer installs, SAML SSO for enterprise; support SCIM + org provisioning.
- Data handling: ephemeral KV cache allowed, but must not persist customer source code unless opt-in. Audit trails required for enterprise customers.
- Model ops: version pinning, rollout groups, canarying, automatic fallback to quantized small-model for offline/offload.

Why Redwood: liked the model catalog + rollout controls and Optimize suggestions for batching. Interested in Hosted for fast start and Dedicated for enterprise customers. Private (on-prem) is a future ask for air-gapped/regulated customers.

Recent interactions / timeline:
- 2025-11-18: Lead created from VS Code marketplace install analytics.
- 2025-12-03: Intro call (Marisol) — product fit, high-level reqs capture.
- 2026-01-09: Demo — streaming + pinning walkthrough; SE present (Rohit).
- 2026-02-22: Security questionnaire submitted (SSO, retention, kms) — replied with initial answers.
- 2026-03-02: Cost sensitivity call; asked for unit cost breakdown for 1M tokens/month.
- 2026-03-08: Internal signalled interest in Dedicated for enterprise tier; requested pricing deck.
- 2026-03-10: Alignment call — agreed to a 2-week POC focusing on streaming latency and per-user rate-limits (fireflies call id above).

POC scope (agreed):
- Deploy Redwood Hosted endpoints with streaming enabled + model pin to a stable 13B open model.
- Integrate extension streaming SDK and measure end-to-end latency from keystroke to first token and continuous chunks.
- Test per-user throttles + simulated multi-tenant bursts (1k concurrent).
- Validate audit log entries and SSO flow for 2 enterprise test accounts.
- Deliver perf report + recommended config for Dedicated sizing if Hosted doesn't meet SLOs.

Known constraints / risks:
- EU data residency: SparrowCode has pilot EU customers and requires log residency; Redwood's EU capacity needs verification.
- Budget: VP Eng expects costs to be capped — needs clear committed spend options for Dedicated.
- SDK integration: their extension is built on a custom streaming layer; small integration work for Redwood SDK expected.

Stitched notes / AE shorthand:
- "Prefer hosted to move fast; Dedicated if cost/SLO demand it."
- "Pin model per org + canary per extension version is a must."
- "Need strong observability counters for per-token billing to show customers."

Suggested AE playbook items:
- Schedule POC kickoff with SE + infra on 2026-03-22.
- Share Hosting vs Dedicated cost model and a recommended Dedicated pool size for 1k concurrent devs.
- Provide EU-region availability matrix + data residency FAQ.
